points.description: Names the stack operation as push (or an unambiguous equivalent such as 'push onto the stack', 'insert at the top of the stack'). The word 'push' alone earns full marks.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if the answer only describes adding/inserting an element onto the stack without naming push or otherwise identifying the top-of-stack insertion operation.

levels.says: Says only that an element is added/inserted (e.g. 'add to the stack', 'insert an item') without naming push or specifying insertion at the top of the stack.

rubric.notes: Full marks for 'push' or any wording that clearly identifies pushing onto the stack as the operation matching enqueue. Half marks for a vague answer that only says an element is added or inserted, with no mention of push or of the top of the stack. No marks for naming a different stack operation such as pop, or for an unrelated answer.
